name: Ruy López — Berlin Defense
description: The Berlin Defense — famously dubbed 'the Berlin Wall.' After 3...Nf6 4.O-O Nxe4, Black sacrifices the knight temporarily for structural play. The Berlin Endgame after Bxc6 dxc6 dxe5 Nf5 Qxd8+ Kxd8 is a battleground of modern top-level chess.

lines.name: Berlin Defense — Main Line (Berlin Endgame)
lines.description: Black plays 3...Nf6 attacking e4. After 4.O-O Nxe4 5.d4 Nd6 6.Bxc6, White gives up the bishop pair but saddles Black with doubled c-pawns. After 7.dxe5 Nf5, the queens are exchanged with Qxd8+ Kxd8, entering the famous Berlin Endgame where both sides must master pawn structure and king activity.
